name: When is the best time to start thinking about senior-friendly home remodeling?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to start thinking about senior-friendly home remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to consider senior-friendly home remodeling is proactively, before urgent needs arise. Planning early allows for thoughtful design choices and a less stressful renovation process. It can be particularly beneficial when a homeowner is still active but anticipating future mobility changes. This approach allows for gradual modifications that integrate seamlessly into the home, rather than reactive changes made during a crisis, ensuring long-term comfort and safety.
